title: AI is not replacing engineers: It is empowering them
content: Engineering has always been about improving lives and shaping a better future. Today, artificial intelligence (AI) is augmenting the ability of engineers to create new solutions and to advance technology for the benefit of humanity. At the National Academy of Engineering (NAE), we see AI as an intelligent assistant that empowers engineers to be more creative, more efficient, and more impactful than ever before.
